followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the reported same-day trucker obstruction as an intentional crossing-access restriction, with the customs spokeswoman’s operational qualification. The affected direction, nationality and exhaustive vehicle categories remain unknown. A plan to target Georgian trucks is not treated as proof of actual Georgian-only obstruction or a complete customs shutdown. Retain 15 September 2018 as same-day evidence and withhold numeric day duration. The attributed two-to-three-hour description and midnight onset are reported detail, not measured elapsed time or a full-day closure. Retain Trade and protectionism / Trade and transport protests as the truckers’ stated grain-transport grievance, not an independently verified protectionist government closure. The main origin is the named customs spokeswoman interviewed by NEWS.am. The Zhamanak review is a prospective secondary report, and its original article was not inspected. Retain unlocated Bagratashen–Sadakhlo access scope with null coordinates. No all-lane closure, passenger-wide point marker or national frontier line is inferred.
